# XPhotography — Atlanta Editorial Photographer (Xavier Jordan)

> Editorial wedding, portrait, family, and corporate photography in Atlanta, Georgia. Documentary in spirit, cinematic in finish. Owner-operated by Atlanta native Xavier Jordan since 2018.

## Services
- Weddings & Engagement — full-day editorial documentary coverage, Atlanta + destination
- Portraits & Family — personal, family, maternity, senior, headshot, studio or natural light
- Corporate & Brand — executive headshots at scale, brand portraits, event coverage, commercial license

- Service area: Metro Atlanta, statewide Georgia, destination on request

## FAQ — common questions
1. Q: How early should I book a wedding photographer in Atlanta?
   A: For Saturdays in April, May, October, and November, six to twelve months ahead is typical. Peak weekends close quickly.

2. Q: How long until I receive my wedding gallery?
   A: Four to six weeks for a fully edited, color-graded gallery. A small preview set arrives within the first week.

3. Q: How long is a portrait session?
   A: Standard editorial portrait sessions run ninety minutes and cover two locations or two outfit changes.

4. Q: How long do corporate headshots take per person?
   A: Twelve to fifteen minutes per executive once lighting is set. A team of ten is typically a three-hour day.

5. Q: Do you travel outside Atlanta?
   A: Yes. Statewide Georgia is included. Destination weddings and out-of-state corporate days are quoted with travel and a planning consult.
